entities.text: Bhemsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The complainant lodged a report at police station Crime Branch Indore for commission of offence of cheating and forgery.
Accordingly a case has been registered against the applicant Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this offence.
There is no legal evidence available on record to connect the applicant with the aforementioned offence.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, no further custodial interrogation of the applicant is required..
Applicant is in custody since 16/10/2021
Final conclusion of trial shall take sufficient long time.
Co-accused Deepak has been enlarged on bail by Hon'ble Apex Court vide order dated 23/01/2023 passed in SLP (Cri) no. 11243/2022.
Case of co-accused Deepak is identical to present applicant, therefore on the ground of parity, present deserves for grant of bail.
Per-contra, learned GA for respondent - State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection stating that four criminal antecedent has been found against the applicant.
In reply, counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been acquitted in all four case and also showed copies of judgment of acquittal in four cases.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case dairy.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 75,000/-
(Rs. Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C., Certified copy, as per Rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE amol Bhemsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28435972/
